title: NASA experiment: tardigrades survive 18 months in the vacuum of space

tellings.quote:
NASA did an experiment
where they survived 18 months in the
vacuum of space.

plain: A guest named Dr. Gilbert says that NASA, the US space agency, ran an experiment outside the International Space Station in which tardigrades, tiny eight-legged animals, survived 18 months in the vacuum of space. He tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels as a point about how tough some life can be, which matters to the question of whether life can survive beyond Earth.
